sloka: अपश्यन्ती तव मुखम् परिपूर्णशशिप्रभम् ।कृपणा वर्तयिष्यामि कथम् कृपणजीविकाम् ॥२-२०-४७॥
transliteration: apaśyantī tava mukham paripūrṇaśaśiprabham ।kṛpaṇā vartayiṣyāmi katham kṛpaṇajīvikām ॥2-20-47॥

translations.english: Without beholding your face that is as bright as the full Moon, how can this wretched woman live this pitiable life?
